passages.text: After Jesus was born in Bethlehem in Judea, during the time of King Herod, Magi from the east arrived in Jerusalem, asking, “Where is the One who has been born King of the Jews? We saw His star in the east and have come to worship Him.”
passages.sermon:
Jesus was born in Bethlehem.
Bethlehem is in Judea.
King Herod ruled at that time.
Magi came from the east.
The Magi arrived in Jerusalem.
The Magi asked a question.
They said, “Where is the One who has been born King of the Jews?”
The Magi saw His star in the east.
They came to worship Him.
passages.original: Τοῦ δὲ Ἰησοῦ γεννηθέντος ἐν Βηθλέεμ τῆς Ἰουδαίας ἐν ἡμέραις Ἡρῴδου τοῦ βασιλέως ἰδοὺ μάγοι ἀπὸ ἀνατολῶν παρεγένοντο εἰς Ἱεροσόλυμα λέγοντες Ποῦ ἐστιν ὁ τεχθεὶς βασιλεὺς τῶν Ἰουδαίων εἴδομεν γὰρ αὐτοῦ τὸν ἀστέρα ἐν τῇ ἀνατολῇ καὶ ἤλθομεν προσκυνῆσαι αὐτῷ

passages.text: When King Herod heard this, he was disturbed, and all Jerusalem with him.
passages.sermon:
King Herod was the ruler at that time.
King Herod heard about the birth of Jesus.
King Herod became disturbed.
All the people in Jerusalem were also disturbed with him.
passages.original: Ἀκούσας δὲ ὁ βασιλεὺς Ἡρῴδης ἐταράχθη καὶ πᾶσα Ἱεροσόλυμα μετ’ αὐτοῦ

passages.text: And when he had assembled all the chief priests and scribes of the people, he asked them where the Christ was to be born.
passages.sermon:
King Herod was the ruler at that time.
He gathered all the chief priests.
He gathered all the scribes of the people.
He asked them a question.
He wanted to know where the Christ would be born.
passages.original: καὶ συναγαγὼν πάντας τοὺς ἀρχιερεῖς καὶ γραμματεῖς τοῦ λαοῦ ἐπυνθάνετο παρ’ αὐτῶν ποῦ ὁ Χριστὸς γεννᾶται

passages.text: “In Bethlehem in Judea,” they replied, “for this is what the prophet has written: ‘But you, Bethlehem, in the land of Judah, are by no means least among the rulers of Judah, for out of you will come a ruler who will be the shepherd of My people Israel.’”
passages.sermon:
The chief priests and scribes answered King Herod.
They said, "The Christ will be born in Bethlehem in Judea."
They explained, "This is written by the prophet."
The prophet wrote, "Bethlehem, you are in the land of Judah."
"You are not the least among the rulers of Judah."
"A ruler will come out of you, Bethlehem."
"He will shepherd my people Israel."
passages.original: Οἱ δὲ εἶπαν αὐτῷ Ἐν Βηθλέεμ τῆς Ἰουδαίας οὕτως γὰρ γέγραπται διὰ τοῦ προφήτου Καὶ σύ Βηθλέεμ γῆ Ἰούδα οὐδαμῶς ἐλαχίστη εἶ ἐν τοῖς ἡγεμόσιν Ἰούδα ἐκ σοῦ γὰρ ἐξελεύσεται ἡγούμενος ὅστις ποιμανεῖ τὸν λαόν μου τὸν Ἰσραήλ

passages.text: Then Herod called the Magi secretly and learned from them the exact time the star had appeared.
passages.sermon:
Herod was the king.
Herod called the Magi.
He called them in secret.
He asked the Magi about the star.
He wanted to know the exact time the star had appeared.
The Magi told Herod when the star appeared.
passages.original: Τότε Ἡρῴδης λάθρᾳ καλέσας τοὺς μάγους ἠκρίβωσεν παρ’ αὐτῶν τὸν χρόνον τοῦ φαινομένου ἀστέρος

passages.text: And sending them to Bethlehem, he said: “Go and search carefully for the Child, and when you find Him, report to me, so that I too may go and worship Him.”
passages.sermon:
King Herod sent the Magi to Bethlehem.
He spoke to them.
He told them to go.
He told them to search carefully for the Child.
He told them to report to him when they found the Child.
He said he wanted to go and worship the Child too.
passages.original: καὶ πέμψας αὐτοὺς εἰς Βηθλέεμ εἶπεν Πορευθέντες ἐξετάσατε ἀκριβῶς περὶ τοῦ παιδίου ἐπὰν δὲ εὕρητε ἀπαγγείλατέ μοι ὅπως κἀγὼ ἐλθὼν προσκυνήσω αὐτῷ

passages.text: After they had heard the king, they went on their way, and the star they had seen in the east went ahead of them until it stood over the place where the Child was.
passages.sermon:
The Magi were wise men from the east.
They listened to King Herod.
They left to continue their journey.
They had seen a special star in the east.
The star went ahead of them.
The star led them on their way.
The star stopped over the place where the Child was.
passages.original: Οἱ δὲ ἀκούσαντες τοῦ βασιλέως ἐπορεύθησαν καὶ ἰδοὺ ὁ ἀστὴρ ὃν εἶδον ἐν τῇ ἀνατολῇ προῆγεν αὐτούς ἕως ἐλθὼν ἐστάθη ἐπάνω οὗ ἦν τὸ παιδίον

passages.text: When they saw the star, they rejoiced with great delight.
passages.sermon: The Magi saw the star.\r\nThey felt very great joy.\r\nThey rejoiced with delight.
passages.original: ἰδόντες δὲ τὸν ἀστέρα ἐχάρησαν χαρὰν μεγάλην σφόδρα

passages.text: On coming to the house, they saw the Child with His mother Mary, and they fell down and worshiped Him. Then they opened their treasures and presented Him with gifts of gold and frankincense and myrrh.
passages.sermon:
The Magi were wise men from the east.
They came to the house.
They saw the Child.
Mary, His mother, was with Him.
They fell down before the Child.
They worshiped Him.
They opened their treasures.
They gave Him gifts.
They gave gold.
They gave frankincense.
They gave myrrh.
passages.original: καὶ ἐλθόντες εἰς τὴν οἰκίαν εἶδον τὸ παιδίον μετὰ Μαρίας τῆς μητρὸς αὐτοῦ καὶ πεσόντες προσεκύνησαν αὐτῷ καὶ ἀνοίξαντες τοὺς θησαυροὺς αὐτῶν προσήνεγκαν αὐτῷ δῶρα χρυσὸν καὶ λίβανον καὶ σμύρναν

passages.text: And having been warned in a dream not to return to Herod, they withdrew to their country by another route.
passages.sermon:
The Magi saw a dream.
God warned them in the dream.
God told them not to return to Herod.
The Magi obeyed the warning.
They did not go back to Herod.
They returned to their own country.
They traveled by a different road.
passages.original: Καὶ χρηματισθέντες κατ’ ὄναρ μὴ ἀνακάμψαι πρὸς Ἡρῴδην δι’ ἄλλης ὁδοῦ ἀνεχώρησαν εἰς τὴν χώραν αὐτῶν

passages.text: When the Magi had gone, an angel of the Lord appeared to Joseph in a dream. “Get up!” he said. “Take the Child and His mother and flee to Egypt. Stay there until I tell you, for Herod is going to search for the Child to kill Him.”
passages.sermon:
Joseph was the husband of Mary.
Mary was the mother of Jesus.
The Magi had just left.
An angel from the Lord appeared to Joseph in a dream.
The angel spoke to Joseph.
The angel said, “Get up.”
The angel said, “Take the Child.”
The angel meant Jesus.
The angel said, “Take His mother.”
The angel said, “Flee to Egypt.”
The angel said, “Stay there until I tell you.”
The angel said, “Herod will search for the Child.”
The angel said, “Herod wants to kill Him.”
passages.original: Ἀναχωρησάντων δὲ αὐτῶν ἰδοὺ ἄγγελος κυρίου φαίνεται κατ’ ὄναρ τῷ Ἰωσὴφ λέγων Ἐγερθεὶς παράλαβε τὸ παιδίον καὶ τὴν μητέρα αὐτοῦ καὶ φεῦγε εἰς Αἴγυπτον καὶ ἴσθι ἐκεῖ ἕως ἂν εἴπω σοι μέλλει γὰρ Ἡρῴδης ζητεῖν τὸ παιδίον τοῦ ἀπολέσαι αὐτό

passages.text: So he got up, took the Child and His mother by night, and withdrew to Egypt, where he stayed until the death of Herod. This fulfilled what the Lord had spoken through the prophet: “Out of Egypt I called My Son.”
passages.sermon:
Joseph was the husband of Mary and the earthly guardian of Jesus.
Joseph obeyed the angel’s command.
Joseph got up at night.
Joseph took the Child Jesus and His mother Mary.
Joseph left for Egypt with them.
Joseph stayed in Egypt.
He remained there until Herod died.
This action fulfilled the word of the Lord.
The Lord had spoken through the prophet.
The Lord said, “Out of Egypt I called My Son.”
passages.original: Ὁ δὲ ἐγερθεὶς παρέλαβεν τὸ παιδίον καὶ τὴν μητέρα αὐτοῦ νυκτὸς καὶ ἀνεχώρησεν εἰς Αἴγυπτον καὶ ἦν ἐκεῖ ἕως τῆς τελευτῆς Ἡρῴδου ἵνα πληρωθῇ τὸ ῥηθὲν ὑπὸ κυρίου διὰ τοῦ προφήτου λέγοντος Ἐξ Αἰγύπτου ἐκάλεσα τὸν υἱόν μου

passages.text: When Herod saw that he had been outwitted by the Magi, he was filled with rage. Sending orders, he put to death all the boys in Bethlehem and its vicinity who were two years old and under, according to the time he had learned from the Magi.
passages.sermon:
Herod was the king.
Herod saw that the Magi had outwitted him.
Herod became very angry.
Herod sent orders.
Herod killed all the boys in Bethlehem.
He also killed all the boys in the surrounding area.
He killed every boy who was two years old or younger.
He did this according to the time he learned from the Magi.
passages.original: Τότε Ἡρῴδης ἰδὼν ὅτι ἐνεπαίχθη ὑπὸ τῶν μάγων ἐθυμώθη λίαν καὶ ἀποστείλας ἀνεῖλεν πάντας τοὺς παῖδας τοὺς ἐν Βηθλέεμ καὶ ἐν πᾶσι τοῖς ὁρίοις αὐτῆς ἀπὸ διετοῦς καὶ κατωτέρω κατὰ τὸν χρόνον ὃν ἠκρίβωσεν παρὰ τῶν μάγων

passages.text: Then what was spoken through the prophet Jeremiah was fulfilled: “A voice is heard in Ramah, weeping and great mourning, Rachel weeping for her children, and refusing to be comforted, because they are no more.”
passages.sermon:
The prophet Jeremiah spoke a message from the Lord.
This message became true at that time.
People heard a voice in Ramah.
There was weeping and great mourning.
Rachel wept for her children.
She refused to be comforted.
Her children were gone.
passages.original: τότε ἐπληρώθη τὸ ῥηθὲν διὰ Ἰερεμίου τοῦ προφήτου λέγοντος Φωνὴ ἐν Ῥαμὰ ἠκούσθη κλαυθμὸς καὶ ὀδυρμὸς πολύς Ῥαχὴλ κλαίουσα τὰ τέκνα αὐτῆς καὶ οὐκ ἤθελεν παρακληθῆναι ὅτι οὐκ εἰσίν

passages.text: After Herod died, an angel of the Lord appeared in a dream to Joseph in Egypt.
passages.sermon:
Herod died.
An angel of the Lord appeared to Joseph.
The angel appeared in a dream.
Joseph was in Egypt.
passages.original: Τελευτήσαντος δὲ τοῦ Ἡρῴδου ἰδοὺ ἄγγελος Κυρίου φαίνεται κατ’ ὄναρ τῷ Ἰωσὴφ ἐν Αἰγύπτῳ

passages.text: “Get up!” he said. “Take the Child and His mother and go to the land of Israel, for those seeking the Child’s life are now dead.”
passages.sermon:
An angel of the Lord appeared to Joseph in Egypt.
The angel spoke to Joseph in a dream.
The angel said, “Get up.”
The angel told Joseph to take the Child.
The angel told Joseph to take the Child’s mother.
The angel told Joseph to go to the land of Israel.
The angel said, “Those who wanted to kill the Child are dead.”
passages.original: λέγων Ἐγερθεὶς παράλαβε τὸ παιδίον καὶ τὴν μητέρα αὐτοῦ καὶ πορεύου εἰς γῆν Ἰσραήλ τεθνήκασιν γὰρ οἱ ζητοῦντες τὴν ψυχὴν τοῦ παιδίου

passages.text: So Joseph got up, took the Child and His mother, and went to the land of Israel.
passages.sermon:
Joseph was in Egypt.
Joseph got up.
Joseph took the Child.
Joseph took the Child’s mother.
Joseph went to the land of Israel.
passages.original: Ὁ δὲ ἐγερθεὶς παρέλαβεν τὸ παιδίον καὶ τὴν μητέρα αὐτοῦ καὶ εἰσῆλθεν εἰς γῆν Ἰσραήλ

passages.text: But when he learned that Archelaus was reigning in Judea in place of his father Herod, he was afraid to go there. And having been warned in a dream, he withdrew to the district of Galilee, and he went and lived in a town called Nazareth. So was fulfilled what was spoken through the prophets: “He will be called a Nazarene.”
passages.sermon:
Joseph was the earthly father of Jesus.
Joseph learned that Archelaus ruled Judea.
Archelaus was the son of Herod.
Joseph became afraid to go to Judea.
God warned Joseph in a dream.
Joseph left for the region of Galilee.
Joseph arrived in Galilee.
Joseph lived in a town called Nazareth.
This fulfilled what the prophets said.
The prophets said, “He will be called a Nazarene.”
passages.original: ἀκούσας δὲ ὅτι Ἀρχέλαος βασιλεύει τῆς Ἰουδαίας ἀντὶ τοῦ πατρὸς αὐτοῦ Ἡρῴδου ἐφοβήθη ἐκεῖ ἀπελθεῖν χρηματισθεὶς δὲ κατ’ ὄναρ ἀνεχώρησεν εἰς τὰ μέρη τῆς Γαλιλαίας καὶ ἐλθὼν κατῴκησεν εἰς πόλιν λεγομένην Ναζαρέτ ὅπως πληρωθῇ τὸ ῥηθὲν διὰ τῶν προφητῶν ὅτι Ναζωραῖος κληθήσεται
